title: Tools
intro: WordPress’s Available Tools page is nearly empty: it links to the Categories and Tags Converter importer. This page lists the Backdrop administration tools that have no WordPress counterpart in the menu.

links.title: Configuration
links.description: every setting of core and modules, grouped by topic

links.title: Reports
links.description: status report, available updates, recent log messages

links.title: Performance
links.description: page cache, CSS/JS aggregation; clear all caches

sections.heading: Converter
sections.text: WordPress’s Categories and Tags Converter swaps terms between the two taxonomies. In Backdrop a term belongs to one vocabulary; move it by editing the term, or re-create it in the other vocabulary.
